note: Carried in Many.warm. Lean gets 6*L*load in one linarith step without stating the intermediate (2 ell+2) L, and its forced bound 2*E*zeta <= load is slightly stronger than f_l <= L.

refine ⟨posted hq,_,Hk.more ?_,?_⟩
   · have ht:=hp _ _ ht 0 (Nat.zero_le _) _ hb|>.1 _ (Q x) t
     simp only [pow_zero,one_mul] at ht; let dX:= coinFee G Pts 0 L -- shadow.
     have hL:1 ≤ ((L).val:ℝ):=by exact_mod_cast (L).pos
     have he : dX ≤ 1:= by apply (div_le_one (simpleH ..)).mpr; refine (le_trans (show Doors.rate L ≤ 1 from Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hL (by norm_num)) ?_); unfold Graces.host; apply le_add_of_nonneg_right; have he := Extra.Histories.Motion.orbitCost_one_le ((Labels.frames G).level 0); positivity
     have hxi : 1 ≤ (Blush.glyph y)⁻¹:= (one_le_inv₀ (Blush.glyphpos _)).mpr ((Blush.glyph_eq A.B.a m) ▸ (glyphBound A.B.a m).2)
     have hx' :0 ≤ E:= (dew M Wx).2.1; have hζ:0≤ζ:= mul_nonneg zero_le_two (Real.exp_pos _).le; have hm':0 ≤ MergeProof.load M:= M.profit.trans ((Q x|>.p).loMass _ _ M.profit)
     have hy : p+p ≤ MergeProof.load M:= ht.1.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left hm' he); have h' : (E+E)*ζ ≤ MergeProof.load M:= by exact (le_mul_of_one_le_left (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hx' hx') hζ) hxi).trans (ht.2.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left hm' he))
     rw [add_mul] at h'; rw [mul_assoc 6]; linarith only [h',hy,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hm', le_mul_of_one_le_left hm' hL,hm'] -- nc

proof_context.conclusion: From p+p <= load, (E+E)*zeta <= load and exp(base) <= L, linarith gives 2*(p + exp(base)*load) + E*zeta <= 6*L*load.
